# Feature: Still tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #71 (Still tile) from Time, Gates and Exits before it is used in real levels. Effect: timer pauses while you stand there. Unique: freezes the clock only while you stand and do nothing. Useful: a safe thinking spot that costs you progress. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** timer pauses while you stand there.

**So that** a safe thinking spot that costs you progress.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Still tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-71-still-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a still tile in sight of a guard's corridor. A player who stands on it to think and then steps off in the direction they had planned discovers that the guard's cycle had been waiting on their next input rather than on the clock, which teaches what the pause actually holds still and what it does not. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While you stand on it the timer display pauses and shows a held icon
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Enemies move on inputs so nothing else advances either
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping off resumes the clock
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It buys thinking at the cost of standing still

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Still tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-71-still-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
